Stop 1
Field kit​: Hand lens
Time limit​: 8 min.
Explore the rock exposed at this site. Read the following questions (B1 and B 2), and circle
one letter that corresponds to the correct answer.

B 1. What is the most appropriate rock type at this site?

    a) Sedimentary rock
    b) Volcanic rock
    c) Plutonic rock
    d) Metamorphic rock

B 2.What is the most appropriate name of the rock at this site?

         g) Basalt                                       a) Limestone
         h) Chert                                        b) Tuff
         i)   Mudstone                                   c) Obsidian
         j)   Gabbro                                     d) Sandstone
         k) Gneiss                                       e) Schist
         l)   Granite                                    f) Rhyolite

Stop 2
Field kit​: Clinometer
Time limit​: 8 min.
Explore the plane marked by red tape at this site. Read the following questions (B 3 and B 4),
and circle one letter that corresponds to the correct answer.

B 3. What is the name of the dominant plane at this site?
    a) Bedding plane

b) Joint plane
c) Unconformity plane
     d) Cleavage plane
